results.content:
From similar reported cases, the most effective resolution steps are:

   1. Turn off any VPN, proxy, or anonymizing service being used.
   2. Clear the browser cache and cookies for Microsoft sites.
   3. Close and reopen the browser, then try the ISO download again.
   4. If the issue persists, try a different browser or network (for example, a different Wi‑Fi or mobile hotspot) to rule out local network filtering.
   5. If none of the above works, contact Microsoft Support and provide the message code 715-123130 and the correlation ID shown in the error so they can check whether the IP, region, or account is being blocked.

results.title: Windows 11 24H2 Gaming Issues and Image Myth Debunking | Windows Forum
results.content: # Windows 11 24H2 Gaming Issues and Image Myth Debunking. * Separately, throughout late 2024 there was a high-profile compatibility problem affecting several Ubisoft games after the Windows 11 24H2 feature update (games freezing, black screens, or becoming unresponsive). Microsoft put a protective block in place to stop devices with those affected games from being upgraded automatically, and both Microsoft and Ubisoft issued fixes/patches over the following weeks. * Microsoft added a compatibility hold: devices that had the affected Ubisoft titles detected would not be offered the 24H2 feature update via regular Windows Update. * Ubisoft released hotfixes for some titles (for example Star Wars Outlaws and Avatar: Frontiers were patched early on), which then allowed Microsoft to lift the block for devices where those games were updated to patched versions. If you’re the person who left a one-star review because your game stopped working after trying a Windows 11 image or update, here’s a practical, step-by-step troubleshooting guide and safety checklist. * If you upgraded to Windows 11 24H2 via Windows Update and now a Ubisoft game breaks: check Microsoft’s known-issues and the compatibility hold guidance before forcing anything. * If problems persist, gather logs and reach out to support: save Windows Event Viewer logs, game error logs, DxDiag (DirectX Diagnostic Tool) output, and provide them to Ubisoft/Microsoft support or post with those logs on forums. “I installed what I thought was a ‘Windows 11 image’ to play some Ubisoft games, and now the games crash/unfreeze/are unplayable. I later discovered the link I used didn’t actually host Windows — it was just an access page — and that a broader problem existed: Windows 11 version 24H2 caused crashes with several Ubisoft games for many users. Steps I recommend: don’t run unofficial images, update your games and GPU drivers, roll back within Windows Recovery if you can, and contact support with logs if necessary. For the broader Windows 11 24H2 incident with Ubisoft games, there’s clear public documentation: Microsoft acknowledged the issue, blocked upgrades for affected PCs, and Ubisoft shipped patches; many of the troubleshooting measures above helped users recover. Ubisoft's Quick Fixes for Windows 11 24H2 Gaming Bugs. Ubisoft Fixes Windows 11 24H2 Game Performance Issues.

results.content:
# Broken Image Generation System – Killing Creative Workflows

Dear OpenAI Team,

I’m writing to express serious frustration with the current state of your image generation tools—specifically the recent “upgrades” that have crippled functionality for creators like me.

Here’s what I’ve experienced:

### :cross_mark: What’s Broken

:cross_mark:

Face Referencing Is Inconsistent  
Despite uploading a face reference image, the tool fails to reproduce consistent likeness—even when using the exact same prompt. This is unacceptable for character-driven projects.

Rate Limits Are Overly Harsh  
Trying to iterate on a visual—adjusting poses, muscles, or clothing—now hits cooldowns constantly. I can’t even refine a single design without being locked out for 10+ minutes. [...] Prompts Are Getting Flagged for No Reason  
Clean, anatomically focused prompts (like a side view squat in gym wear) are being blocked with vague “content policy” violations, even when nothing inappropriate is requested.

Body Proportions Are Wildly Inaccurate  
Female characters end up with bulky, masculine arms, or glitched proportions, even when detailed measurements are provided. This wrecks the consistency of carefully developed designs.

Old Tools Worked Better  
Before the so-called upgrade, I could at least generate my character consistently, with face accuracy and fewer restrictions. Now I get more broken results, fewer options, and more wait time.

### :bullseye: What I Need as a Creator

:bullseye: [...] ### :bullseye: What I Need as a Creator

:bullseye:

If OpenAI wants to support real creators—those building deep lore, stories, and characters—you need to fix the system you broke and start empowering creators, not stifling them.

Right now, it feels like you’re tuning the platform for casual toy use, not for professionals or world-builders.

I hope this gets taken seriously, because this platform has incredible potential. But if these issues aren’t addressed soon, you’re going to lose the people who care the most.

Sincerely,  
A seriously disappointed creator
